name: Elise
source:
She is a princess of the "Kingdom of Vagustine" from the land of knights. She wants to experience martial arts, and not just be a spectator.

She has the face of a dignified princess and the face of a child trying to learn Japanese culture that she is unfamiliar with. She can be stubborn and refuse to change her mind on things she believes in.

She is always pestering Clarice and her security personnel (SP) with her desire to "see the world beyond the castle walls with my own eyes and walk with my own feet," and her curiosity to know various things.
